valid:
name: Release
on:
  push:
    tags: ['v*.*.*']
permissions:
  contents: write
  id-token: write
jobs:
  release:
    steps:
      - run: npm run release:check
      - run: test "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" = "v$(node -p \"require('./package.json').version\")"
      - run: npm publish --provenance --access public
      - run: npm view "${PACKAGE_NAME}@${PACKAGE_VERSION}" version
      - run: |
          if gh release view "$GITHUB_REF_NAME"; then
            gh release edit "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" --notes-file notes.md
            gh release upload "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" package.tgz --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" package.tgz
          fi
